summary.name: DALL·E 2 Prompt Engineering Guide
summary.one_liner: A community-written Google Doc guide to prompt modifiers (art styles, photorealistic terms, lighting, and more) for getting better image results from DALL·E 2.
use_cases: Learning which modifiers change the style of AI-generated images
Finding photorealistic prompt terms for lighting and camera angles
Looking up artist-style modifiers for image prompts
Seeing examples of how DALL·E 2 interprets specific phrases
Creating product design or photoshop-style asset images
summary.what_it_does: The document is a prompt engineering guide for DALL·E 2, created by community members (@rendo1 and @luc on Discord). It is organized into sections on art styles and art-related modifiers, including artist modifiers used in the form ", by [modifier]". It has a photorealistic modifiers section with sub-categories such as macro, lighting, situational, and other, with DALL·E 2 examples linked. Further sections cover original or experimental styles, product design examples, Photoshop assets, and DALL·E 2's misses. The visible page text does not include the actual example images or the full modifier lists.
notable: Written by community members (@rendo1 and @luc on Discord) rather than OpenAI
Includes real DALL·E 2 example outputs linked from modifier terms
Covers a section on where DALL·E 2 misses or fails to interpret prompts
caveats: Targets DALL·E 2 specifically, so modifier behavior may differ in other image generators or newer models
Visible page text is mostly the Google Docs interface; the guide's actual content is only partly shown
Listed in a third-party awesome list rather than an official source
